name: Voxel List Construction Using Histogram Pyramids
aliases: Voxel List Construction via Histogram Pyramid Traversal
definition: A GPU algorithm to initialize voxel lists in parallel using histogram pyramids to count non-zero elements and map linear indices to input coordinates.
summary: Voxel List Construction Using Histogram Pyramids initializes sparse voxel lists on the GPU by using a hierarchical histogram structure to deterministically map linear indices to spatial coordinates.
